items.title: Alvin Alcorn and Eddie Marrero Interview, 1979-12-04
items.q: But Renee, he's not a good corner friend. ... He was a corner friend. He's treated with me.

ctx.x: Yeah. When I stopped, it was, Kate Renee, that after my daddy died in nineteen nineteen, my brother Simon took six.

ctx.s: Alvin Alcorn (co-interviewee / Marrero family member, NOT interviewer)
ctx.x: Uh-huh. And I used to go playing his play.
